description: This PHP script acts as a sample client implementation for the TestLink API, demonstrating how to report test case results with execution duration. It sets up test parameters, maps status codes, initializes an XML-RPC client, and calls the 'reportTCResult' method.

classes.name: IXR_Client
classes.description: A client class for making XML-RPC requests, instantiated with the server URL.

methods.name: show_api_db_sample_msg
methods.description: Displays a sample message indicating the API database sample.

methods.name: runTest
methods.description: Executes the test by making an XML-RPC call using the provided client, method name, arguments, and test number.
